turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I got a message about my cholesterol results.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Your total cholesterol is 215 and your LDL is 140.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: The LDL is above the target of 100 for you.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Let us try diet changes for three months first, then recheck.
